recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied core change without altering the already-correct element definition or making Extension Pack edits; related extension lifecycle issues should remain tracked outside this core reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-37795 was Applied/Persuasive by Patient Care and requested elevating the flag-detail extension use case into the Flag base resource as Flag.supportingInfo 0..* with constrained references and explanatory examples.
initial_application: Commit 937fb2c6f5f1b380f51a516f39b528920877c4e9 added Flag.supportingInfo to source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml. Commit 377796869b1517d83a3a9a7a7a898dbddf244508 later extended the target list for FHIR-56379. The structural element was present, but the Flag introduction still described the old common extension as the linkage mechanism.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Flag as an active Patient Care resource, so the Flag introduction is current-build source. FHIR-41366, FHIR-41368, and the linked Zulip discussion clarify that flag-detail remains appropriate for earlier FHIR versions while R6 should identify Flag.supportingInfo as its replacement. The Extension Pack currently carries that replacement note for flag-detail.
reconciliation: Changed source/flag/flag-introduction.xml in the Boundaries and Relationships section to link to Flag.supportingInfo and to frame flag-detail as the earlier-version mechanism instead of the current R6 mechanism.
source_changes: source/flag/flag-introduction.xml: Replaced stale current-build guidance pointing to the flag-detail extension with guidance pointing to Flag.supportingInfo and a note that flag-detail served this purpose in earlier FHIR versions.
